# /etc/mavlink-router/main.conf
# Generated by installmavlinkrouterorangepizero3w on 2026-10-29T02:25:39Z
#
# Orange Pi Zero 3W (Allwinner A733) pin map for the flight controller:
#   header pin 11 = UART2 TX  -> flight controller RX
#   header pin 13 = UART2 RX  -> flight controller TX
#   header pin 14 = GND            -> flight controller GND
# Do NOT cross-connect TX->TX. Do NOT power the FC from the Pi's 5V.

[General]
TcpServerPort=5678
ReportStats=false
MavlinkDialect=auto

[UartEndpoint fc]
Device = /dev/ttyS2
Baud = 57600
# If your FC's baud is uncertain, mavlink-router can probe a list instead:
# Baud = 57600,115200,921600

# --- Optional: stream to a ground station over the network -------------------
# [UdpEndpoint gcs]
# Mode = Normal
# Address = 192.168.1.50
# Port = 14550

#### orangepiEnv.txt
verbosity=1
bootlogo=false
overlay_prefix=sun60i-a733
fdtfile=allwinner/sun60i-a733-orangepi-zero3w.dtb
rootdev=UUID=4ca786d8-960f-46c1-b884-452766317293
rootfstype=ext4
